newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nippon Express warehouse to open June 97.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Express warehouse to open June 97.

text.p: The Paris airports authority, ADP, said Nippon Express's new freight centre, currently under construction at CDG, should enter service in June 1997.
The Japanese air freight forwarder's former installations at CDG were completely destroyed by fire in October 1995.
Since then Nippon has occupied 4,500 sq.m of warehousing and office space in one of ADP's freight centres at CDG, an ADP official told Reuters.
"Nippon had already planned an extension before the fire took place and its new centre will be double the capacity of its former facilities."

Situated on the same site and representing an investment of 32 million francs, it will comprise 7,200 sq.metres of warehousing and 2,800 sq metres of offices, the official said . -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
